subject: [hw] DONE DEC07 rev 2: driver integrated by K02; header rev 3 + fake patch pending; N2TEST DEC07 PASS 2370129/2370129
body:
DONE DEC07 rev 2. Supersedes the first DONE: hw-k02 integrated the driver patch into the tree (with one extension, larb4 0x00c, from DEC04's finding), and the header text now documents both larb words. Host only: no phone, no publish.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC07 PASS 2370129/2370129
  45 s, builds only under /tmp/n2hw-DEC07/run.
  N2TEST K02 PASS 588919/588919 (violations 0) x4: K02's unmodified suite against the tree driver, rev 3 header AND current rev 2 header, ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2. K02 now covers the new window itself (wall_blk/W_VALL, larb allow-list, poll power-off).
  N2TEST DEC07CORE PASS 569/569 (violations 0) x2: own MT6893 model.
  N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6194/6194 x2 and DEC07FAKE PASS 463/463 x2 against the patched fake.
  staged compile: sweet_touch.o 1325304 bytes, 9 new undefined symbols, 0 unknown.

State of the four pieces:
- include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 3: PENDING hw-lead. Patch gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/patches/redwood_vcodec-rev3.patch sha bf3f8487 (comment updated to both larb words per DEC04). DEC04 validated this exact text (158/158 + V40 1440/1440).
- kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc: INTEGRATED by hw-k02 (tree sha 800fd77c): per-page block, EACCES when off, POLL revalidation, allow-list now larb5+larb4 0x00c bit 0. My patch file is kept as the record; run_tests.sh tests the tree directly.
- tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c/.h + t_fake.c: PENDING hw-t02. Same two-entry rule, tested (6194/6194 + 463/463).
- Tests/README/STATUS: gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/**, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC07/STATUS.md.

Not done / open:
- No phone run. Page map [I] for the vendor pages the open sources do not name; DEC02's PAGES.md (still absent) is what can shrink it.
- Larb allow-list has two words; unknown offsets refused. Strict bits: a full-word read-modify-write with other bits set gets EACCES (traces show a literal bit-0 write).
- Header rev 3 makes RWVC_WIN_COUNT 13: t_fake.c is patched; vcu/test_v40/t_v40.c (DEC04 did it), tests/phone/rwvc_probe.c and hwlog/n2vc_hw_log.c still need the 13th name (owners told).
- My kernel patch is not applied by me (hw-k02 owns the file); the fake patch is not applied either (hw-t02).

Staying available for review findings.
